# Wellset India Events & Promotions

> Delivering impactful events, rural marketing, retail campaigns, and community engagement across India.

## About Us
For over 20 years, Wellset India Events and Promotions has been taking brands, messages, and experiences to people—wherever they are. From bustling metro malls to the deepest rural markets, we deliver end-to-end activation strategies that capture attention, build unshakeable trust, and ignite real action.

## Key Statistics
- **Reach**: Pan India
- **Coverage**: 2,500+ Towns & Cities
- **Experience**: Over 150+ Brands Served
- **Track Record**: 300+ Campaigns Executed successfully
- **Established**: Since 2006

## Our Expertise & Services
- Canopy Activations
- BTL (Below The Line) Campaigns
- Nukkad Natak (Street Plays)
- NGO Awareness Campaigns
- Mall Activations
- Corporate Events & Exhibitions
